record.description: Distinct latent states may project to identical observable outputs; inversion is then underdetermined without further constraints. Foundational link between Eclipse–Omega and inverse problems.
record.note: For a declared linear map F, equal outputs of distinct inputs give a nonzero kernel difference. General nonlinear maps require fibre-based analysis; x squared at plus and minus one supplies a collision with nonzero local derivatives.
